tools.name: connect
tools.description: Connect a Google / Gmail account via OAuth. Returns the authorisation URL or confirms an existing connection.

tools.name: connect_microsoft
tools.description: Connect a Microsoft Outlook / Office 365 account via OAuth. Returns the authorisation URL or confirms an existing connection.

tools.name: connect_yahoo
tools.description: Connect a Yahoo / AOL account via OAuth. Returns the authorisation URL or confirms an existing connection.

tools.name: connect_imap
tools.description: Connect any email account via IMAP/SMTP — iCloud, Zoho, custom domains. Auto-detects server settings when possible.

tools.name: status
tools.description: Show all connected email accounts with provider type, active flag, and unread count for each.

tools.name: switch_account
tools.description: Switch the active email account used by subsequent inbox / read / send operations.

tools.name: disconnect
tools.description: Remove a connected email account. Purges stored credentials and cached inbox pages.

tools.name: inbox
tools.description: Show inbox messages with cursor-based pagination. Supports folder keys inbox / sent / spam / trash / drafts / starred.

tools.name: read_email
tools.description: Read the full content of an email message by its ID — subject, sender, body (text + html), attachments.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search emails by sender, subject, keywords, or any provider-supported query — Gmail search syntax is honoured.

tools.name: folder
tools.description: Browse a mail folder with cursor-based pagination — sent, spam, trash, starred, drafts, all, archive, unread.

tools.name: get_thread
tools.description: View a full email thread / conversation by thread ID — returns all messages in reply chronology.

tools.name: send
tools.description: Send a new email. Requires to, subject, and body; cc / bcc optional. Uses the active account unless specified.

tools.name: reply
tools.description: Reply to an email. Uses the message_id you read last if not specified; body required. Adds In-Reply-To headers.

tools.name: forward
tools.description: Forward an email to a new recipient with an optional comment prepended to the forwarded message body.

tools.name: archive
tools.description: Archive an email — moves it out of the inbox without deleting.

tools.name: delete
tools.description: Move an email to Trash. Recoverable until trash is purged.

tools.name: mark_read
tools.description: Mark an email as read — clears the unread flag.

tools.name: mark_unread
tools.description: Mark an email as unread — restores the unread flag.

tools.name: star
tools.description: Star or unstar an email — toggles the starred / important flag.

tools.name: move
tools.description: Move an email between folders — INBOX, Junk, Trash, Archive, or any provider-supported label/folder name.

tools.name: purge
tools.description: Permanently delete an email — bypasses Trash, cannot be recovered by the provider.

tools.name: bulk_archive
tools.description: Archive multiple emails at once. Expects a comma-separated list of message IDs.

tools.name: bulk_delete
tools.description: Delete (move to Trash) multiple emails at once. Expects a comma-separated list of message IDs.

tools.name: bulk_mark_read
tools.description: Mark multiple emails as read in one batch. Expects a comma-separated list of message IDs.

tools.name: bulk_mark_unread
tools.description: Mark multiple emails as unread in one batch. Expects a comma-separated list of message IDs.

tools.name: contacts
tools.description: Show email contacts — search-filterable, sorted by name.

tools.name: add_contact
tools.description: Add a contact manually by email address, optionally with a display name.

tools.name: sync_contacts
tools.description: Import contacts from a connected email — Google People API, Outlook address book, or recent email header harvest.

tools.name: delete_contact
tools.description: Remove a contact from the address book by email address.

tools.name: mail_action
tools.description: Direct mail action from the UI panel — archive, delete, spam, mark_read, mark_unread, star. Accepts one or many IDs.

tools.name: folder_counts
tools.description: Get unread counts per folder — INBOX, sent, drafts, spam, trash, starred — for UI sidebar badge rendering.

tools.name: get_oauth_url
tools.description: Get an OAuth authorisation URL for the given provider (google or microsoft) — used by the add-account panel.

tools.name: add_imap
tools.description: Connect an IMAP email account from the add-account panel wizard — tests credentials, persists encrypted password.

tools.name: compose_send
tools.description: Send an email from the compose panel — supports reply, forward, and new-message modes.

tools.name: skeleton_refresh_mail_inbox_summary
tools.description: Background per-account unread summary for classifier envelope.

tools.name: skeleton_alert_mail_inbox_summary
tools.description: Alert check for new unread emails.
